name: StockSense
tagline: Demand forecasting and smart reordering for neighbourhood stores
problem: Kiranas, pharmacies and canteens reorder by gut feel
Fast movers run out; customers walk to the next shop
Perishables expire; festival spikes are missed
Enterprise forecasting tools are costly, complex, online-only

stats.label: kirana stores in India (approx., widely cited estimate)
demand lost to empty shelves under gut feel (demo replay)
Diwali-week sweets demand vs a normal day (demo data)

solution: Upload date, sku, qty - get a morning reorder list
4 models backtested per SKU; the best one wins
Safety stock, reorder point, EOQ with shelf-life caps
Every order explained with risk and rupees at stake

features.title: Auto model selection
features.desc: Naive, moving avg, Holt-Winters, regression; rolling backtests pick the best

features.title: Festival-aware
features.desc: Learns last Diwali/Pongal uplift per SKU and plans pre-orders

features.title: Smart reorder list
features.desc: Qty, run-out risk, sales at risk and the maths behind each line

features.title: What-if service level
features.desc: Slider shows holding cost vs lost margin and the optimum

features.title: ABC-XYZ + basket rules
features.desc: Pareto x variability matrix and Apriori shelf/bundle advice

features.title: 90-day simulation
features.desc: Replays real demand: gut feel vs StockSense, side by side

architecture: CSV / demo generator -> validate, detect + impute stock-outs
Festival layer -> learn uplift, de-festival, re-apply
4 forecasting models -> rolling-origin backtest -> best per SKU + sigma
Inventory engine -> safety stock, ROP, EOQ, perishable cap, risk in Rs
Simulator + ABC-XYZ + Apriori -> JSON API (stdlib http.server)
Vanilla JS dashboard -> hand-drawn SVG charts, light/dark, mobile
algorithms: Holt-Winters (additive, weekly, damped) - level, trend, weekday pattern
Ridge regression via Gaussian elimination - weekday, festival, promo effects
Rolling-origin backtesting - leak-free sMAPE/MAPE model selection
Acklam inverse normal - z-score for any service level
Safety stock z*sigma, ROP, EOQ sqrt(2DS/H) - reorder policy
Normal loss function G(z) - expected lost sales in rupees
ABC-XYZ - revenue Pareto x weekly demand CV
Apriori - support, confidence, lift basket rules
innovation: Explainable: every order traces to forecast, sigma, z and EOQ
Honest evaluation: nested hold-out and leak-free simulation
Indian retail realism: festivals, case packs, perishables, stock-outs
Zero install, zero cloud: runs on a Rs 15k laptop

results.label: forecast error vs seasonal naive (WAPE 28.4% vs 47.9%, hold-out)

demo_flow: Load demo data: 40 SKUs, 13 months, Diwali in 19 days

Reorder today: urgent items, row explains ROP and EOQ

impact: Fewer empty shelves: fill rate 84.9% -> 99.6% (demo replay)
Less food waste: 17% fewer expired units, fewer orders
Small shops compete with quick-commerce without big software
Data never leaves the shop; works without internet
business: White-label module for billing and distributor apps
Pilot with campus canteens and FMCG distributors
future: WhatsApp purchase orders per supplier with MOQs
